top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks join the decisive magic-wavelength control principle to a mature, independently reproducible experimental capability. Katori and Ye provide the most defensible compact attribution when the award is confined to the invention and experimental realization of lattice clocks rather than their wider applications.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile; no disclosed collaboration or other recusal-triggering connection with the proposed laureates.
